generationInputs.prompt: The image shows a stylized design incorporating botanical and agricultural elements within a heart shape. A thick, dark green curved line begins at the bottom left, arcs upwards and to the right, forming the left side of a heart shape. Completing the heart on the right is a stylized golden wheat stalk with grains, curving downwards and slightly to the left. Inside the heart shape are representations of four food items, each a different color. The top element is a green apple oriented diagonally from the upper left to the lower right. Below and slightly to the left of the green apple is a yellow banana pointing upwards and slightly to the left. A blue avocado is positioned centrally, pointing downwards and slightly to the left. To the right of the blue avocado is a red apple, oriented horizontally with its stem pointing towards the right. A thin, light green stem extends from the bottom of the blue avocado and extends downwards, partially obscured by the red apple. The entire design is set against a plain white background. The style is flat and graphic, with solid colors and no shading or texture visible.
